signals.failure_scenario: A staging baseUrl like https://reality.example.com/http-proxy/api becomes wss://reality.example.com/ws-proxy/api — the /http-proxy/ segment gets mangled to /ws-proxy/ and the WebSocket connect resolves to a 404. Fix: baseUrl.replaceFirst(Regex("^https?"), if (baseUrl.startsWith("https")) "wss" else "ws").
